notes: Curated, verified, beginner-buyable product pages for recommended boards, keyed by MicroPython board slug. These take precedence over the generated hardware_purchase_links_us.json, whose first link per board is the MicroPython 'More info' link -- a vendor SoC/family page with no add-to-cart. Selection rule: a specific product page with add-to-cart, pre-soldered headers (no soldering required), and a solderless module connector (STEMMA QT / Qwiic) so it pairs with the curated STEMMA QT sensor modules. Same vendor (Adafruit) as the modules, so a beginner checks out one cart.

ESP32_GENERIC_S3.notes: Adafruit Metro ESP32-S3 (16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM). Pre-soldered headers, USB-C, and a STEMMA QT/Qwiic connector for solderless I2C modules. Runs the ESP32_GENERIC_S3 MicroPython build.

RPI_PICO_W.notes: Raspberry Pi Pico WH - Wi-Fi with male headers already soldered (no soldering required). Runs the RPI_PICO_W MicroPython build.
